1.subtitle: What is Budgeting?
1.text: Budgeting is the process of creating a plan for how to use your money each month. Having a budget helps you decide in advance whether you'll have enough to cover both your needs and the things you enjoy.

1.subtitle: The 50/30/20 Rule
1.text: One of the most practical frameworks is 50/30/20. Allocate 50% of your income to Needs, 30% to Wants, and 20% to Savings or repaying debts.

1.subtitle: Getting Started
1.text: 1. List all your income sources. 2. Identify fixed monthly expenses. 3. Evaluate variable spending. 4. Adjust your allocation to match your financial goals.

2.subtitle: Why You Need an Emergency Fund
2.text: An emergency fund is money set aside specifically to cover living costs when something unexpected happens — such as a sudden job loss or an urgent medical expense.

2.subtitle: How Much Should You Save?
2.text: The general recommendation is 3–6 months of living expenses. If your monthly costs are around 5 million rupiah, aim for 15–30 million as your emergency fund target.
